# Transcriber

> Transcriber is a free, open source menu bar app for macOS that records calls from any app (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, WhatsApp, FaceTime, browsers) and writes a live transcript on the Mac itself. Nothing joins the call and no audio leaves the computer. Made by Moritz Krause.

## What it does
- Records two channels at once: the microphone (you) and the system audio (everyone else), using the macOS 14.2 audio tap.
- Transcribes locally with FluidAudio / Parakeet TDT v3, with Silero VAD and pyannote diarization. The models (about 1 GB) are downloaded once; afterwards everything runs offline. The only other network access is the update check against GitHub.
- Separates speakers: the microphone channel is labelled with your name, the remote side is split into Speaker 1, Speaker 2 and so on after the call.
- Echo gate for calls without headphones, so the far end is not transcribed twice. On a 54-minute Zoom call it removed 220 of 225 echo segments.
- Shows the transcript live in a floating bar below the menu bar while the call runs.
- Writes the transcript to a folder per recording: transcript.md (readable, grouped by speaker with timestamps), transcript.jsonl (appended and flushed after every segment, crash-safe), optional transcript.json, transcript.srt, and the raw audio as WAV.
- If the Mac crashes mid-call, the transcript up to the last segment is on disk and the app offers to finalize the session on the next launch.
- Hands the finished transcript to an AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or any website or Mac app) together with an editable prompt template, so a summary or to-do list is one keystroke away.
- Global shortcut Control-Option-Command-R to start and stop. Menu bar dot turns red and shows a waveform and timer while recording.

## What it is not
- Not a meeting bot: it cannot record a meeting you are not attending.
- Not a shared team workspace: transcripts are files in a folder on your Mac.
- Not available for Windows, iOS or Android. Requires macOS 14.2 or newer, Apple Silicon recommended.
- Not on the Mac App Store. Download from GitHub releases.

## Facts
- Price: free. Source code on GitHub: https://github.com/moritzjuliankrause/Transcriber
- Current version: 0.3.2
- Author: Moritz Krause, developer, Germany. https://moritz-krause.com
- Legal note: recording conversations without consent is illegal in many jurisdictions (for example § 201 StGB in Germany). Inform participants before recording.
